faqs.q: Can I earn money from digital marketing without any investment?
faqs.a: Yes, you can start with very little money. Freelancing services such as social media management, content writing or SEO, and affiliate marketing through a blog or social media page, mainly need your skills, a laptop and an internet connection rather than upfront capital.

In affiliate marketing you promote another company's products or services using a unique referral link, and you earn a commission whenever someone buys through that link. It suits people who already have a blog, YouTube channel or social media following in a particular niche.

faqs.q: Which digital marketing skills are most in demand for freelancers?
faqs.a: Commonly requested freelance services include SEO, social media management, content writing, email marketing and paid advertising on search and social platforms. Knowing analytics tools to measure results also makes you more useful to clients, because businesses want to see what their spending achieves.

faqs.q: Do I need a course or degree to start a career in digital marketing?
faqs.a: A degree is not essential, and many people learn digital marketing on their own through practice and free resources. A structured course can help by giving you hands-on projects, experience with tools such as Google Ads and Analytics, and a certificate for your CV, but a portfolio of real results matters most to clients.
